start: ^Lerato Dlamini: Evening. I'm on the phones and the rota tonight.

b: ^Lerato Dlamini: You again. Go on, before the phone goes.

c-0: ^Lerato Dlamini: Quiet is how it starts. Then the early markets wake and every line lights up.
^Lerato Dlamini: And I've not eaten since I came in.
c-1: ^Lerato Dlamini: Me, Tomasz on the support queue, and Dani, wired on coffee.
c-2: ^Lerato Dlamini: Mind the coffee machine. It bites.

ex_floor_after_irina: ^Lerato Dlamini: Did you see the police come through?
^Tomasz Wisniewski: I did. Two officers, very quiet.
^Lerato Dlamini: Nobody has told us a thing.
^Tomasz Wisniewski: I only keep the queue running.
^Lerato Dlamini: Same. The floor won't run itself.
ex_floor_after_seizure: ^Lerato Dlamini: My phone hasn't stopped all night.
^Tomasz Wisniewski: The queue climbs. Callers everywhere.
^Lerato Dlamini: And I've no idea what to tell them.
^Tomasz Wisniewski: Then we answer, and we say very little.
^Lerato Dlamini: Politely. That part I can do.
